Text: Your game is fine. Theirs is famous. Votes follow fame, so let us shift some.
Hover a voter to see who they follow, how much they weigh and if you can flip them.
Click a voter to Plug your game at them. Each Plug costs one Post.
The ring is conviction. Plug until it drains and the voter flips to you.
Posts refill slowly. Spend them on voters with many followers, not on lurkers.
Plug your own voters to reinforce them. Even fans need a little love.
A padlock marks a gate. A hub ignores you until enough of its followers back you. The rival and the other games play by the same rule.
The gate opened because its followers came around. That is the honest way.
Hold SHIFT for the night shift: sockpuppets ignore gates, so you can crack a celebrity. Sticky Keys in the way? Press N.
Night shift is loud: each sockpuppet adds {sockheat} Heat and holding SHIFT adds {heatrate} a second. Heat cools only when you let go.
The Mod Eye sweeps every 12 to 35 seconds (see the countdown up top). Above the red tick when it passes, you take a strike.
Strike! The mods undid your sockpuppets and shadowbanned you for {ban} seconds. {strikes} strikes and you are out; they do not wear off.
One more strike ends you. Once per jam, Shift the Blame (click the bar below, or B) if your strikes took under {blamefake}% fake votes.
Space pauses. M mutes. Esc opens the menu. The rest is up to you.
A voter changed sides. A shaking ring means it is drifting; a closing coloured ring means another game is about to plug it.
Fake votes keep you hot while you hold them. A strike undoes them all and the audit the unbacked: plug one to {launder} to back it.
Final audit: fake votes are purged, and so is every sockpuppet vote bought in the last {review}s, even if backed.
Right-click a voter you hold to Rally it: {rallycost} Post shields it and its neighbours from plugs for {rallylock}s. Ready in {rallycd}s.
A ring closing in on your voter is an attack, in the attacker's colour. Click the voter to parry it, or Rally it and its neighbours.
The Mod Eye looks away! For {eyeaway}s night shift adds no Heat: hold SHIFT, sockpuppet a big voter, then plug it to back it.
Votes bought with sockpuppets are fake: they heat you up while you hold them. Keep them under {fakelimit}% or a strike takes them all.
The rival goes all-in for the last days: a burst of attacks, then it runs low on Posts. Yours refill {pushpct}% faster, so spend them.
You lead the board. The other games pile onto whoever is first, so expect closing rings in every colour.
The other games fight too: they pile onto the leader and can take a hub from it. A note says who took what.
You lead by more than {sympathy} points, so voters start rooting for the underdog. Your lead drifts back: keep reinforcing.
Take a voter from a colour and it comes for it for {grudge}s: expect a ring in its colour on the voter you just took.
